connector.name: Liveauth MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for LiveAuth: PoW + Lightning auth, L402 bundles, and paid MCP tool receipts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dulzuradev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LIVEAUTH_API_BASE

env.name: LIVEAUTH_DEMO
env.description: Force demo mode even with a key set. Defaults to false.
